visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.personality: Signs in and checks their own session — proves auth end to end

mira.name: Mira Kovač
goals: Get a piece finished without anyone seeing it early
mira.description: Writes and edits her own drafts, cannot publish them
mira.personality: Rewrites the opening four times. Leaves things in draft for weeks and expects them to still be private.

jon.name: Jon Adeyemi
goals: Ship the week’s posts on time
jon.description: Decides what goes live and when
jon.personality: Reads the whole thing before touching the button, and schedules rather than publishing on a Friday.
